justification: Pure single-use per-sender composition of exact caller-owned TLS retry traffic-secret evidence, repository-owned fixed-memory HKDF, key derivation, monotonic record state, repository-owned in-memory TLS 1.3 record protection, and caller-owned wipe-on-drop storage. It performs no filesystem, network, DNS, process, environment, clock, entropy, credential access, signing, certificate, trust-root, path-validation, hostname, revocation, audit, HTTP, OAuth, or external effect.
